title: A Field Length Bound
statement: For every finite list $ws$ of Boolean words and every word $w$ occurring in $ws$, the length of $w$ is at most the length of the packed encoding of $ws$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list $ws$ of Boolean words
A Boolean word $w$ that belongs to $ws$
replaced: For every list of words and every member $w$ of the list, the length of $w$ is at most the length of the packed encoding of the whole list; the doubled bits and separators make the bound immediate without random access.
